every compound-specific empirical claim in the supplied query prior or cited

claims.claim: Imipramine-N-oxide, a dibenzoazepine closely related to the query scaffold, showed ~100% systemic availability after oral dosing in healthy volunteers, supporting high F for this tricyclic azepine class.

Thalidomide, a neutral, poorly soluble tricyclic drug with a similar physicochemical profile, showed high oral bioavailability (80-100%) in humans, demonstrating that poor solubility does not preclude F>=20%.
Tolfenamic acid, another lipophilic poorly soluble drug, showed ~91-100% oral bioavailability, further supporting high F for lipophilic drugs with challenging solubility.
